**q03**, on *set the source weights*. The publisher feed matched 64% of the 2025 corrections; past corrections matched 22%.

A. Weight the feed 0.6, the export 0.3, past corrections 0.1 (recommended: mirrors the 2025 hit rates)
B. Equal weights until the backtest runs
C. Feed only for now

Gate: no. If you skip it, the lead already applies A.
Reply: a letter, y = take the recommendation, later = skip, or your own text.

q10.text:
The test fills the disk until the cache evicts, and eviction deletes tiles. `tiles_shared` is 41 GB and holds the 308-district full-region batch that the live map stack reads, so B risks the one volume that must never be dropped, night window or not.

A copies it to a scratch database first (about 25 minutes on box-1), and the test deletes only there. C is safe but one district is about 140 MB, which never fills the disk, so eviction would not trigger at all.

q09.text:
C drops the whole zoom band, so every pan after a large batch is a cold read until the band refills: at zoom 14 that is back to the 640 ms baseline for about 50 s. The bench on 40,000 tiles:

| mode | commit | stale tiles |
|---|---|---|
| inline (A) | 9.8 s | none |
| queued (B) | 1.4 s | up to 48 s |
| drop band (C) | 0.3 s | none, but cold cache |

B keeps commits fast and only leaves stale tiles for under a minute.
